summary: Validation and submission logic in RegisterRequestPage.tsx were updated to require only name, phone number, and location, and to supply defaults for brand and requestType when calling createRequest. However, due to truncation of the form JSX, the diff summary does not provide clear evidence that the Brand selection UI and Request Type radio group were removed from the rendered booking form.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the booking (request registration) form to remove the Brand selection UI and the Request field (Request Type selection) so users are no longer asked for those inputs.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows createRequest being called with defaulted brand and requestType, but the JSX portion is truncated and does not explicitly show removal of the Brand dropdown/Specify Brand input or the Request Type (service/spares) radio group from the UI.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/updated project tracking metadata for feature requests (AR-1..AR-4) in project_state.json.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest requirements are strictly about simplifying the booking form UX/validation/defaults; updating project_state.json with AR entries is not requested by the spec.
